method: Same process, alternating order; first pair warm-up excluded; medians of six isolated runs. Local ephemeral Linux fixture; not a Windows/NAS speed claim.

record_structure_bytes.scope: FileEntry object plus instance dictionary only; excludes referenced strings/scalars and enclosing list.

new_tests: tests/test_inventory_v1.py: 12 passed; previous tests not rerun

environment.storage: ephemeral local filesystem, warmed by alternating repeated scans

fixture.scan: 30 numbered parent folders, one deeper child per parent, 50 one-byte TXT files per child; 1,500 files total
fixture.summary: 20,000 synthetic FileEntry records under Reports/2026/June; logical sizes i % 8192; same metadata fields supplied to both versions

caveats: Measured optimized source was uncommitted while preparing 0.6.0; baseline modules were loaded from the stated commit.
These are warm local Linux fixture timings, not Windows, NAS, cold-cache, arbitrary-file or whole-application benchmarks.
Metadata safety reads were retained; asymptotic complete traversal remains linear in visited entries plus path processing and optional sorting.
FileEntry structure measurements exclude referenced strings/scalars, enclosing containers and allocator overhead.
The later .folder-organizer-rust exclusion adds a state-directory name; that directory was absent from the measured fixture.
The twelve previously passed new inventory cases were not rerun for the state-directory exclusion; its one new targeted test passed separately.
